title: Know The Law| When Can A Right Be Waived? Supreme Court Explains
description: The Supreme Court recently explained the concept of waiver of rights as an intentional relinquishment of a right, advantage, benefit, claim or privilege that the person may have enjoyed. Pertinently, the key to waiving a right is that it must first be known to the person; that is, he must be aware of his existing right.� On May 13, a bench comprising Justice Dipankar Datta and Justice AG Masih awarded extraordinary compensation of Rs. 1.25 crore to a former driver of the Central Reserve Police F
